description: Every metric the manufacturer dashboard shows, defined once. t = snapshot month; 3 months = t-2..t; prior 3 months = t-5..t-3; 12 months = t-11..t. Revenue = observed claims revenue. Screens reference these IDs; the API serves them from the listed source.

metrics.label: Monitored operators
metrics.definition: Distinct operators with at least one qualifying claim in the 12 months ending t, with the change vs t-1.
metrics.empty: No claims in the last 12 months.

metrics.label: Operators by data state
metrics.definition: Monitored operators split into scored, dormant (no activity for the configured dormant months), too little history, and data incomplete.

metrics.label: Flagged operators
metrics.definition: Distinct scored operators in the High or Medium band of the operator model, with the change vs t-1.

metrics.label: Operators by risk band and size
metrics.definition: Scored operators per band (High, Medium, Low), each split by size band (Small, Mid, Large) and shown as a share of scored operators.

metrics.label: Revenue by window
metrics.definition: Observed revenue in the last 1, 3 and 6 months, each compared with the same window 12 months earlier when 12 or more months of history exist, otherwise with the window just before it.

metrics.label: Revenue exposure
metrics.definition: Observed revenue in the 3 months ending t for flagged operators, at the operator grain only. Not a forecast of lost revenue.

metrics.label: Tier movement
metrics.definition: Per band: operators in the band at t and at t-1, retained (in the band both months), new (entered the band at t, including newly scored), and the net change.
metrics.empty: Shown from the second published snapshot.

metrics.label: Band transitions
metrics.definition: Operators by band at t-1 (rows, plus not scored) against band at t (columns, plus dormant). A cell opens the queue filtered to those operators.
metrics.empty: Shown from the second published snapshot.

metrics.label: Operators trending churn
metrics.definition: Operators flagged at both t-1 and t, by size band, plus new entrants flagged for the first time at t.
metrics.empty: Shown from the second published snapshot.

metrics.label: Lost operators
metrics.definition: Operators in the High band at t-1 with no qualifying activity in month t, by size band. Marked provisional until month t's reporting matures.
metrics.empty: Shown from the second published snapshot.

metrics.label: Flagged operators over time
metrics.definition: Flagged operators, revenue exposure and lost operators for the last 12 published snapshots.

metrics.label: What kind of decline
metrics.definition: Flagged operators by main pattern: buying less overall, dropping product lines, narrowing products, price-led, or reporting caution. The pattern is the main theme of the operator's explanation, else its strongest driver family.

metrics.label: Flagged lines and products
metrics.definition: Operator + product line and operator + product pairs in the High or Medium band of their own model. Shown beside flagged operators, never added to them.

metrics.label: Review coverage
metrics.definition: Flagged operators with a review recorded for snapshot t, divided by flagged operators.

metrics.label: Data freshness
metrics.definition: Snapshot month, latest claim date received, and the date risk was scored.

metrics.label: Reporting completeness
metrics.definition: Share of expected claims for the last 2 months received by the cutoff, measured with data known at the cutoff.

metrics.label: Risk score and band
metrics.definition: Operator model score for no qualifying claims activity next month, scaled 0 to 100, its band, and the change in points vs t-1. A ranking, not a calibrated chance.

metrics.label: Data state
metrics.definition: Scored, dormant, too little history, or data incomplete. Shown as a badge wherever the operator appears.

metrics.label: What is happening
metrics.definition: The first reason title of the validated explanation, else the strongest driver's plain label, with the operator's pattern.

metrics.label: Owner
metrics.definition: Account owner and team from the manufacturer's ownership source, as of t.

metrics.label: Revenue exposure
metrics.definition: This operator's observed revenue in the 3 months ending t.

metrics.label: Monthly revenue
metrics.definition: Observed revenue for each of the 12 months ending t, last 3 months highlighted.

metrics.label: Spend vs prior 3 months
metrics.definition: Revenue in t-2..t divided by revenue in t-5..t-3, minus 1.
metrics.empty: Shows "Too little history to compare" when the prior window is zero or fewer than 6 months are observed.

metrics.label: Activity records
metrics.definition: Qualifying claim records per month. Labelled records, not orders: one record is not one purchase occasion.

metrics.label: Active months
metrics.definition: Months with qualifying activity in the last 6 months, out of the months observed (fewer than 6 for new relationships).

metrics.label: How late is the next order?
metrics.definition: Months since the last active month against the typical gap between active months over 12 months, shown on an on-schedule, late, very-late scale. Uses days instead when the source has real activity dates.

metrics.label: Usual gap between orders
metrics.definition: Median months between active months over the 12 months ending t.

metrics.label: Product lines and products
metrics.definition: Distinct product lines and products bought in the 3 months ending t, against the most bought in any 3-month window of the 12 months.

metrics.label: Product lines bought each month
metrics.definition: Which product lines had activity in each of the 12 months ending t.

metrics.label: Monthly quantity
metrics.definition: Units per month for the 12 months ending t, within one compatible unit group.
metrics.empty: Hidden when units are mixed and no conversion is configured.

metrics.label: Top product line share
metrics.definition: Largest product line's share of the operator's revenue in the 3 months ending t.

metrics.label: Price change on the same products
metrics.definition: Change in agreement price for products bought in both t-2..t and t-8..t-6, weighted by recent quantity. Isolates price from a change in what is bought.

metrics.label: Discount off list
metrics.definition: One minus agreement revenue divided by list-price value, for the 3 months ending t.

metrics.label: Billback ratio
metrics.definition: Billback amount divided by revenue, for the 3 months ending t.

metrics.label: Reporting completeness
metrics.definition: Share of this operator's expected claims for the last 2 months received by the cutoff, with the average claim delay. Below policy, a caveat shows on the verdict card and queue row.

metrics.label: Spend vs usual
metrics.definition: Average monthly revenue in the 3 months ending t against the observed lifetime monthly average and the peak month.

metrics.label: Share of observed portfolio
metrics.definition: Operator revenue divided by all monitored revenue in the 3 months ending t, with its percentile rank. Not market share.

metrics.label: Why this operator is flagged
metrics.definition: Validated explanation: a summary, 3 or 4 reasons tied to evidence, and caveats. The deterministic summary from the data shows while pending or when unavailable.

metrics.label: What raised and lowered the risk
metrics.definition: Top class-normalised drivers with plain labels, observed value, comparison value and a strength word.

metrics.label: Signals at three levels
metrics.definition: The operator's band, flagged product lines out of lines bought, flagged products out of products bought, and the highest-risk line. Never an averaged score.

metrics.label: Price vs similar operators
metrics.definition: Like-for-like price: this operator's line prices and its peer group's, both weighted by this operator's own volume mix. Shown as above or below peers with the peer group, its size and whether it was widened.

metrics.label: Lines similar operators buy
metrics.definition: Product lines bought by at least half of the peer group that this operator does not buy, with peer volume and average price.

metrics.label: Agreements bought under
metrics.definition: Agreement IDs and their share of the operator's revenue in the 3 months ending t. Context only: an agreement ID does not establish terms, expiry or renewal.

metrics.label: Review status
metrics.definition: Latest review status and disposition for this operator at snapshot t.

metrics.label: Line risk
metrics.definition: Operator + product line model score and band, with the change vs t-1.

metrics.label: Line status
metrics.definition: Buying; Buying less (spend vs prior 3 months below -15%); or Stopped (no activity in the last 2 months after earlier activity).

metrics.label: Revenue and share of operator
metrics.definition: Line revenue over the 12 months ending t and its share of the operator's revenue.

metrics.label: Volume vs prior 3 months
metrics.definition: Line quantity in t-2..t divided by t-5..t-3, minus 1.

metrics.label: Monthly volume
metrics.definition: Line quantity per month for the 12 months ending t.

metrics.label: Price trend
metrics.definition: Agreement price per month with the peer average. The list price is added only when a real list price is supplied.

metrics.label: Price change, 6 months
metrics.definition: Change in the line's agreement price on the same products, t-2..t vs t-8..t-6.

metrics.label: Products in this line
metrics.definition: Each product's status, share of line revenue and volume trend; the top product's share of the line.

metrics.label: Peer prices for this line
metrics.definition: Lowest, highest and average line price across the peer group (one revenue-weighted line price per peer), the spread, and how many peers buy the line. Shown as a table of numbers or as a spread chart; the reader switches between them.

metrics.label: Line insight
metrics.definition: Validated explanation for the line prediction, under the same rules as the operator explanation.

metrics.label: Product risk
metrics.definition: Operator + product model score and band, with the change vs t-1.

metrics.label: Product status
metrics.definition: Buying, Buying less or Stopped, with the same rules as line status.

metrics.label: Monthly quantity
metrics.definition: Product quantity per month for the 12 months ending t.

metrics.label: Revenue and share of line
metrics.definition: Product revenue over the 12 months ending t and its share of the operator's line revenue.

metrics.label: Agreement price
metrics.definition: Latest agreement price and its change vs t-8..t-6.

metrics.label: Price trend
metrics.definition: Agreement price per month with the peer average, and the list price when supplied.

metrics.label: Price vs similar operators
metrics.definition: This operator's latest price for the product against the peer group's average price for the same product.
metrics.empty: No similar operator buys this product.

metrics.label: Discount off list
metrics.definition: One minus agreement price divided by list price, latest month bought.

metrics.label: Billback, 12 months
metrics.definition: Billback amount for this operator and product over the 12 months ending t.

metrics.label: Last bought
metrics.definition: Last active month and the number of months bought out of 12.

metrics.label: Product down, line steady
metrics.definition: Product spend fell below -15% vs prior 3 months while the line's total did not. A pattern worth checking, not proof of substitution.

metrics.label: Replaced by
metrics.definition: The mapped replacement product the operator now buys, from the manufacturer's replacement map.

metrics.label: Product insight
metrics.definition: Validated explanation for the product prediction, under the same rules as the operator explanation.

metrics.label: Operators buying
metrics.definition: Distinct operators with activity in the product line in the 3 months ending t.

metrics.label: Flagged operator relationships
metrics.definition: Operator + product line pairs for this line in the High or Medium band.

metrics.label: Revenue exposure
metrics.definition: Revenue in the 3 months ending t of flagged operator + line pairs, at the line grain only.

metrics.label: Volume trend
metrics.definition: Line volume across all operators per month, and t-2..t vs t-5..t-3.

metrics.label: Operators buying less or stopped
metrics.definition: Operators whose line status is Buying less or Stopped at t.

metrics.label: Products losing operators
metrics.definition: Products in the line ranked by flagged operator relationships and operators who stopped.

metrics.label: Hit rate at review capacity
metrics.definition: Of the top N operators by score (N = configured monthly review capacity), the share with no qualifying activity next month, on matured months only.

metrics.label: Catch rate at review capacity
metrics.definition: Of operators with no qualifying activity next month, the share that were in the top N by score, on matured months only.

metrics.label: Ranking quality (AUC)
metrics.definition: Area under the ROC curve on matured outcomes; 0.5 is a coin flip.

metrics.label: Calibration (Brier)
metrics.definition: Mean squared error between score and outcome on matured months; lower is better.

metrics.label: Inactivity rate by month
metrics.definition: Share of eligible relationships with no qualifying activity next month, per matured month. Swings point to data or population issues before model drift.

metrics.label: Track record
metrics.definition: Per matured snapshot: operators flagged High, how many were inactive next month, hit rate and catch rate.

metrics.label: Input drift
metrics.definition: Population stability index per feature, last snapshot vs training window: stable up to 0.1, watch up to 0.2, check above 0.2.

metrics.label: Feed coverage
metrics.definition: Expected vs received claim feeds per distributor and month, as known at each cutoff.

metrics.label: Explanation validity
metrics.definition: Share of generated explanations that passed schema and evidence checks, and the cache hit rate.

metrics.label: Explanation feedback
metrics.definition: Helpful vs not right votes on explanations this snapshot.

metrics.label: Review dispositions
metrics.definition: Share of reviewed cases closed as confirmed decline, reporting issue, normal pattern, moved to another supplier, or other.
